issues.quote: Some green chaos whirled around me
At last we are home. The white walls of the house bring my senses back. As soon as the carriage rolled onto the wide green yard
lay across the deep blue spaces
submerged at the bottom of the black darkness
the creak of the floor under their weight
drown myself in the black darkness
Yet there, beyond my wall, something is.
my eye would manage to catch the image of people
the soft horsehair mattresses of the furniture

strengths.quote: seized the carriage by all its wheels
my eyes drowned in it as in a sea and searched for something to catch hold of
It was so quiet that I felt ashamed of the pounding of my own heart.
Ten black rooms, filled with darkness to the brim.
I close the door, as if I feared the light of the lamp would leak out through the cracks.
strengths.why: fresh inversion of light and dark

strengths.quote: I hear the solidity and shape of furniture
everything would suddenly leap back into its place: chairs, sofas, windows, even the cornices
all those who left their faces in mirrors, their voices in cracks and corners
